subject: PDF device doesn't print dotted linetype

messages.author: add19d4c933279ac
messages.subject: PDF device doesn't print dotted linetype
parts:
Dear all,

I am having a problem where the dotted linetype will not show up in
the output from the PDF graphics device. I am using ggplot2 0.8.3 with
R version 2.9.2 on Mac OS X. When I run the following code...

### start code
library(ggplot2)

fakeData <- data.frame(cbind(x = 1:100, y = rep(0:4, each = 100) +
rnorm(500,0,.1), z = rep(1:5, each = 100)))

ggplot(fakeData, aes(x = x, y = y)) + geom_line(aes(linetype = factor
(z)))

pdf(file = "testing.pdf")
last_plot()
dev.off()
### end code

... the topmost line shows up in the initial Quartz output, but not in
the produced PDF. Has anyone else experienced this, and is there a way
to fix it?

Thank you,
Brenton Kenkel

>> ### start code

>> fakeData <- data.frame(cbind(x = 1:100, y = rep(0:4, each = 100) +
>> rnorm(500,0,.1), z = rep(1:5, each = 100)))
>>
>> ggplot(fakeData, aes(x = x, y = y)) + geom_line(aes(linetype = factor
>> (z)))
>>
>> pdf(file = "testing.pdf")
>> last_plot()
>> dev.off()
>> ### end code

Same problem here. I guess this is another issue with the pdf() device
of R. Try using quartz instead since you are on OS X:

quartz(file="testing.pdf", type="pdf")
last_plot()
dev.off()

or

dev.print(quartz, file="testing.pdf", type="pdf")

The type argument is necessary even if it is kind of redundant with
the file argument.

JiHO
